newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing extends drive on securities irregularities.
newsitem.headline: Beijing extends drive on securities irregularities.

text.p: Beijing authorities have decided to tighten their monitoring of securities houses in the Chinese capital, the China Securities newspaper said on Wednesday.

The Beijing branch of the People's Bank of China and the municipal Securities Regulatory Committee ordered an inspection of all brokerages for irregularities, such as overdrafts and improper credits and repurchases, the newspaper said.
The move was in line with a decision by the State Council, or cabinet, to regulate overheated stock markets and boost financial discipline.
The domestic A share markets in Shanghai and Shenzhen have surged dramatically this year.
Several major financial institutions in Shanghai and Shenzhen have been punished for securities irregularities in recent weeks.
